note: Rewritten from Sands' (1999) new species description, original in English; the genus lacks soldiers, only the worker has a complete description; measurements follow the original ranges (the original gives the hind tibia length as 0.779—0.82 mm, reproduced here as printed).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The species is characterized by its large size and long legs. From A. multispinus it differs in that the latter is much smaller, has conspicuous stout setae on the fore coxa, the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible as long as the first marginal tooth, and a lower right mandible index (first to second marginal tooth); the enteric valve ridges are waisted at the base of the apical spines, the spines curved and longer than the narrowest point of ridge three and more numerous on ridges one and three, and the valve three-radiate. From A. spiculatus it differs in that the latter is smaller and has a lower left mandible index; the primary-row spines are conical and more numerous on ridge three, ridges three and four differ in degree of sclerotization while ridge one is unsclerotized and ridge two intermediate, and the valve is bilaterally symmetrical.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish white or pale yellow, the darkest part of the antennal flagellum yellow or pale yellowish brown, pronotum and legs yellowish white, abdominal tergites transparent. Head capsule short-oval, nearly circular, setae numerous but not dense, projecting, the longest setae arranged regularly and symmetrically. Fontanelle absent. Anterior surface of the fore coxa without conspicuous stout setae; fore tibia with 3 distal spurs, the third well developed, at least one-half the length of the others. Left mandible: first marginal tooth nearly equilateral, anterior margin of the third marginal tooth shorter than or equal to that of the first marginal tooth, the fourth marginal tooth just touching the lateral edge of the molar prominence in frontal view or with its proximal end concealed behind the molar prominence; right mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth shorter than that of the second marginal tooth. Measurements: head width 0.765—0.800 mm; pronotum width 0.523—0.582 mm, length 0.230—0.267 mm; hind tibia length 0.779—0.82 mm; fore tibia length 0.614—0.677 mm; left mandible index 0.896—0.978, right mandible index 1.065—1.366.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The midgut–hindgut junction arises ventrally below the nerve cord; the first hindgut segment is rather short, up to nearly 8 times as long as its proximal width, tubular throughout; in the undissected abdomen the enteric valve lies to the right of the heart (dorsal view) or to the left of the nerve cord (ventral view); the third lobe of the enteric valve seat is smaller than the outer pair. The enteric valve ridges are nearly taper-ellipsoid from the base towards the apical spines, with weakly sclerotized, pale yellow or yellow ends; the primary rows bear very long tapering spines, at most 10—14 on each ridge, straight and evenly tapering, not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three; the secondary rows consist of small single spines scattered more or less evenly on the scales, directed backwards; the membrane between and outside the ridges bears minute spines, with marginal scales proximally.
